{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Digital Clamp Meter MESTEK Inrush Current Meter 1000A AC/DC Volt Amp Ohm Meter Clamp on Multimeter True RMS 6000 Counts NCV VFD LOZ Measures Current Voltage Temperature Capacitance Resistance; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for electrical troubleshooting alongside my inspection camera and other measuring tools.
ItemID: NA; Title: Rubber Grommets Kit,Hincell 63Pcs Double Sided Round Rubber Grommet Kit for Wiring Drill Hole Firewall Hole Plugs Wire Protection for Automotive Plumbing, 6 Sizes 5/8" 13/16" 7/8" 1" 1-3/16" 1-1/2"; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: These would protect wires passing through drilled metal, a useful complement to my drilling and riveting supplies.
ItemID: NA; Title: EDSRDXS 24PCS Super Glue Always Keep Fresh Mini Single Use Tubes for Bonding Plastic, Metal, Ceramic, Wood, Glass, Rubber, etc.; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Small fresh tubes would be convenient for quick repairs when mixing epoxy would be unnecessary.
ItemID: NA; Title: Washers, 304 Stainless Steel Large Fender Washers for Screws Bolts, 235PCS Flat Washers Assortment Set-15 Sizes–M3 M4 M5 M6 M8 M10 M12 for Furniture, Ship Car, DIY Project, Electrical Connections; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This assortment complements my metric bolts and rivet nuts and would help spread loads on thin materials.
ItemID: NA; Title: 335PCS Self Tapping Screws 410 Stainless Steel #8#10 Self Drilling Screws TEK Head Sheet Metal Screws, Wafer Head & Hex Washer for Metal, Wood, Plastic, Car and Furniture; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these for sheet-metal fastening because they add useful head styles to my existing screw supplies.
ItemID: NA; Title: FOLIV 315Pcs 1/4-20 x 1/2" to 1-1/2" Button Head Socket Cap Screw Bolts Nuts Washers Kit, Class 12.9 Alloy Steel, Anti-Oxidation, Full Machine UNC Thread; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The 1/4-20 hardware would pair with my UNC rivet nuts, and button heads would suit exposed assemblies.
ItemID: NA; Title: FlashFix | Super Glue Plus | Industrial Strength Welding Glue & Powder for Filling Gaps | Instant Cure Adhesive for Plastic, Metal, Rubber & More | Heavy Duty Repair on Cars, Boats, & DIY Projects; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Gap filling interests me, but I would choose the simpler glue tubes this time because I have no specific gap repair planned.
ItemID: NA; Title: 4 x 4 Inch Magnetic Field Viewing Film, Magnetic Field Viewer, Magnetic Flux Display, Magnet Pattern Detector, See Magnetic Field for Scientific Project; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current magnet-related project, so this has less immediate use than fastening and repair supplies.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duct Tape Heavy Duty Waterproof Bulk of 5, 11 Mils Black Duct Tape 2 inches x 33 Yards, Max Strength No Residue Industrial Tape, Tear by Hand for DIY Repairs, Industrial, All-Weather Multipurpose Use; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Repair tape fits my interests, but five rolls feels excessive alongside the adhesive tapes I already have.
ItemID: NA; Title: LIONMAX #8 x 1-1/2" Wood Screws, 100 PCS Deck Screws with Star Drive, Tan Coated Exterior Screws for Outdoor Use, Coarse Threads, No Stripping, Anti-Rust, Drive Bit Included; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases suggest more immediate metalworking needs, and I have no outdoor wood project planned."}
